repo_notes: NextVisualizer is an Android audio visualizer library (Kotlin) extracted from the N-Zik project.
Used as a Gradle module (':nextvisualizer') in N-Zik (see N-Zik-Group/N-Zik settings.gradle.kts).
Fork of the Next Visualizer implementation originally created by jeffshee (NextGenVisualizer).
Source is grouped by feature directly under src/main/kotlin/: 'painters/' (fft, waveform, modifier, misc), 'utils/' (VisualizerHelper, FrameManager, Preset), 'views/' (VisualizerView) and 'enums/'.
Rendering happens on a canvas: VisualizerView drives the frame loop, painters draw FFT/waveform effects, modifiers transform the output.
Dependencies: Android SDK 35+, Apache Commons Math3 (FFT), Timber (logging).
Tone: technical library documentation; explain painter/modifier concepts with concrete usage examples.

page_notes.content: Introduction: what the library renders, where it is used (N-Zik), and its relationship to the NextGenVisualizer fork.
Canvas rendering pipeline: VisualizerView, the frame loop (FrameManager), and how painters are composed per frame.
FFT-based painters under painters/fft: FftAnalog, FftBar, FftCBar, FftLine, FftCLine, FftPoly, FftCPoly, FftWave, FftCWave, FftWaveRgb, FftCWaveRgb, FlatWave.
Time-domain waveform rendering under painters/waveform (WfmAnalog) vs the FFT-based effects.
Modifiers under painters/modifier: Beat, Blend, Compose, Glitch, Move, Rotate, Scale, Shake, Zoom - how they wrap/transform a base painter.
Background, Gradient, SimpleText and Icon rendering under painters/misc.
How FFT and waveform captures are read (snapshot seam) and consumed by the painters via VisualizerHelper.
Preset.kt: predefined painter/modifier combinations and how to switch between them.
Adding the library as a Gradle submodule in Android projects (':nextvisualizer').
Android SDK 35+, Apache Commons Math3, Timber (for logging).
